value.rationale: A natural sparse Fourier zero question acquires a universal sharp arithmetic threshold: positive ratios of algebraic degree less than (p-1)/2 cannot cancel, and every allowed p has exceptional rays at the exact minimal degree. Complete support-independent ray classification and exactly two zeros supply a structured boundary beyond a routine computation.
